title: Concept: Gradle repository declared over cleartext
description: build.gradle declares a repository URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Artifacts and their checksums cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can substitute both.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: Artifacts and their checksums cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can substitute both.
